unresolved.behavior: 保留身份与原文，不根据文件名或动作意图补造组件类型。
unresolved.longText: Wrap body and error messages; allow action labels to grow; avoid truncating destructive meaning. Ellipsize content titles only when a full-detail path is available.
unresolved.scaling: Use target text scaling; allow vertical growth, honor safe area/IME, collapse multi-column layouts when columns cannot fit. Test 320dp width and enlarged system text; those are target checks, not source results.
unresolved.keyboardAndFocus: Preserve native roles. Label icons, order focus by reading sequence, focus a modal deliberately and restore its opener on close; test real keyboard and screen reader.
unresolved.backAndRetention: Target defines draft ownership, cancel/commit and reentry explicitly; source-specific differences in interaction records take precedence.
